pathways.title: Computer science & software
pathways.summary: Build useful things with code, logic and a little persistence.

pathways.title: Human sciences & personal services
pathways.summary: Explore practical services, family needs and the details that shape everyday life.
pathways.activity: Compare two college service programs and ask students what their practical classes involve.
pathways.compare: Compare family and consumer sciences, personal-care and funeral-service program requirements.
pathways.route: College certificates, associate and bachelor’s routes vary by service
pathways.caution: Personal care, funeral service and human-science programs prepare for different work. Regulated services have their own approved programs and licensing requirements.

pathways.title: Religion, ministry & community leadership
pathways.summary: Explore religious study, community care and service within a tradition.
pathways.activity: Compare an academic religious-studies course with a ministry-oriented program.
pathways.compare: Ask how a program’s tradition, award and placements connect to the work you want to explore.
pathways.route: Undergraduate and graduate routes; traditions set additional expectations
pathways.caution: Academic religious studies and preparation for religious leadership are distinct. Ordination and other recognition depend on the relevant religious organization.

pathways.title: Interdisciplinary studies & discovery
pathways.summary: Connect subjects and learn how different ways of thinking can address one question.
pathways.activity: Choose a question that needs two subjects and compare how each would approach it.
pathways.compare: Compare the actual subject combination, depth and graduate-study prerequisites in each program.
pathways.route: Often a bachelor’s foundation; specialist destinations can need graduate study
pathways.caution: Interdisciplinary programs contain very different combinations. A shared label is not a common qualifying degree; inspect the actual curriculum and destination requirements.
